Question Choices: Select. A box plot shows Q1 = 100 and Q3 = 180. What percentage does the box represent, from 100 and 180?: ~~25% | 50% | 75% | 100%~~
Hints: Q1 to Q3 spans two of the four quartile portions.
Solution: The box extends from Q1 to Q3 and represents the middle half, or50%, of the distribution. This describes the quartile portion; ties at the boundaries can change the exact number of observations in a closed interval.

Question Choices: Which statement MUST be true if Condition A has min 10 and max 18, and Condition B has min 8 and max 21? Choices: A) All plants in Condition B are taller than Condition A | B) Condition A has a higher maximum height | C) Condition B has both lower minimum and higher maximum | D) Both conditions have the same median Answer with the letter only.
Hints: Choose the claim determined by the given endpoints.
Solution: C is guaranteed: B’s minimum8 is below10, and B’s maximum21 is above18. The median cannot be recovered from endpoints, so D is not guaranteed.
